class.dragonminez.prodigy.passive.desc: Master of everything: you have every other class passive at once (Warrior Fury, Martial Artist finisher, Spiritualist and Cleric cooldowns, Berserker low-HP rage, Tank healing, Unversed Resonance, and the Paladin party shield and lifesteal), and you gain 50% more form mastery and 25% more TP.
